units: Pes. 4ᵃ אכיף ימא א׳ ביראתא on the sea-shore granaries are palaces. [Oth. opin., taking אסיסנא fr. אסס, cmp. אשש, I would establish (build) palaces. Oth. opin., reading אסנא or taking our w. to be = אַסְנָא, at the sea-shore thorn-bushes (a thorn-bush) pass(es) for cypresses (a cypress); v. ברותא.] [Gitt. 69ᵃ, v. סִיסָנָא.]
